method: Measured actual transparent GPU RGBA readbacks, not rerendered or painted images. ViewportTexture readbacks contain premultiplied RGB. Clock ink coverage is recovered by least-squares color unmixing relative to the exact cream fill and INK color, using P*alpha-RGB=(P-I)*inkCoverage. Ring/hand area can differ slightly because direct vector AA and native area reduction differ. Nominal dimensions, raw pixels, mass proxies and visual sheets are separate evidence; no pixel-identical AA claim is made.
